description: This file contains utility functions for managing MCP server configurations, including validation, normalization, prefix handling, and checking module availability within the LiteLLM project.

methods.name: is_mcp_available
methods.description: Checks if the 'mcp' module is available for import.

methods.name: normalize_server_name
methods.description: Replaces spaces with underscores in server names.

methods.name: validate_and_normalize_mcp_server_payload
methods.description: Validates and normalizes server payload fields, ensuring no invalid characters and setting default alias.

methods.name: add_server_prefix_to_name
methods.description: Adds server name prefix to resource names based on format.

methods.name: get_server_prefix
methods.description: Returns the server prefix: alias, server_name, or server_id.

methods.name: split_server_prefix_from_name
methods.description: Splits a prefixed name into server prefix and unprefixed name.

methods.name: is_tool_name_prefixed
methods.description: Checks if a tool name has a server prefix.

methods.name: validate_mcp_server_name
methods.description: Validates that server name does not contain the separator character.
